_doc: Travel & Map Formula D (design/gdd/travel-map.md; values as written there, 25 km tiles). speed: tiles a season by mode (road, wilderness, river down and up, sea; flight by realm id). Values the GDD marks as guesses are listed in guesses. biome_cost: c_p, the travel cost of a tile part by biome (lake and sea are walked around: they carry no cost and are left out of the weights; a sea tile is impassable on foot). road_terrain_share: r_share, how much terrain slows a road (road c_t = 1 + r_share x (c_wild - 1)). travel_speed_floor: f_min, the least travel_speed_pct can slow travel to. partial_season_efficiency: eta, the cultivation rate of a trip's last part-season. flight_drain_per_season: f_drain. tools/design/map/export_continent.py reads biome_cost and road_terrain_share to cost each route; ContinentData.trip_seasons turns a route's cost into seasons. speed.flight: tiles a season by realm (Foundation Establishment opens flight, rule 10; the keys were one realm late before 2026-11-20 and are now the GDD's FE 135, CF 200, NS 290, DT 400). hazard_per_season h[d] and mode_factor m_mode: Formula E's encounter chance 1 - exp(-sum h[d_t] m_mode dt_t) per season of a trip. teleport: rule 11 and Formula K (jump time; fee = round(linh_thach_max[realm] x min(fee_base_frac + fee_per_tile_frac x d, fee_frac_max) x owner_mult), d the straight-line tiles). encounter_place_type: the place type an encounter on the way is drawn for, by the main biome of the tile where the stretch spent most of its time (Formula E; events_templates.json place_types). search: Formula F (sight r = min(r_max, round(r_k sqrt(DS / sense_ref))); p_detect = DS / (DS + H); a season's search chance 1 - exp(-q (v_wild_eff / c_area) (2r + 1) p_detect / A), A a rumour's region wilderness x rumour_area_share or jade_slip_area); rumour_chance, rumour_false_share and rumour_quality: hearing a rumour while exploring a settlement (guesses); secret_hidden: H per tile secret kind (the GDD's guesses); secret_pay: what a found secret pays at once (a buried cache: a share of the realm's linh_thach_max, guess). overview_kinds: the place kinds everyone knows from the start (rule 14), with the famous sites.
